items.prompt: Edit the provided game card illustration. Preserve the exact overhead camera, framing, silver-haired girl's identity, face, hair, black ruffled short dress, gesture, held sword, blue circular energy arc and gray-blue abstract background, and the hand-painted opaque anime block-brush style. Change the airborne weapons dramatically: ALL must be beautiful, unmistakable SWORDS with coherent blades, hilts and sword guards, no axes, spears, knives or random metal shards. Increase the number from roughly ten to about 28-36 visible flying swords in sweeping concentric arcs with deep foreground/background perspective. Design varied elegant silhouettes: slender double-edged Chinese jian, broad leaf-blade swords, graceful flamberge swords, long estocs, crystalline tapering blades, black iron greatswords, white jade swords, a few crescent-guard swords. Each remains a functional recognizable sword, with refined harmonious proportions and tasteful minimal silver/cyan/gold accents. Make 8-10 foreground and midground swords individually legible and beautifully designed, and many smaller background swords suggest an immense sword formation. Avoid identical cloned blocky swords. Keep the character's face and two-finger hand clear and unobstructed; keep visual breathing room at the center. Large matte connected color masses with few directional brushstrokes and selected bright metal edges; no photorealism or texture filter. Preserve original aspect ratio. No text, border or watermark.
